questions.q: What does the General Ledger Trial Balance Report fundamentally confirm?
options: That every account was coded to the correct cost center
That total debits equal total credits across the ledger's accounts for the selected period
That the chart of accounts has no inactive segments
That all subledger transactions have been imported
questions.explain: The historical and functional purpose of a trial balance is to confirm debits equal credits before proceeding toward close.

questions.q: Which trial balance type shows balances as of the start of the fiscal year, useful for confirming opening balances carried forward correctly?
options: Detail
Results
Begin Year
End Year
questions.explain: Begin Year shows balances as of the start of the fiscal year, which is what confirms correct opening balances.

questions.q: Why is a balanced trial balance described as necessary but not sufficient?
options: Because Oracle Fusion does not actually enforce equal debits and credits at journal entry
Because balancing only proves mechanical correctness; it says nothing about whether accounts were coded or valued correctly
Because trial balances are never actually balanced in practice
Because only manual journals affect the trial balance
questions.explain: Debits already must equal credits to post a journal in Oracle Fusion, so a balanced trial balance doesn't confirm coding or valuation accuracy — that's what review is for.

questions.q: What is the Trial Balance – Average Balances report used for?
options: Showing period, quarter, and year average-to-date balances as of an effective date, useful where average balances matter more than point-in-time figures
Replacing the standard Detail trial balance entirely
Only showing budget variances
Listing journal approval history
questions.explain: The Average Balances report shows average-to-date figures, relevant to industries like banking where averages matter more than snapshots.

questions.q: Once a trial balance is reviewed and accepted, what does it become the source data for?
options: Nothing further — it is a standalone, disposable report
Preparing the income statement and balance sheet, which regroup the same trial balance accounts into a different presentation
Only the next period's budget
Resetting the chart of accounts
questions.explain: Financial statements are structurally built from the same trial balance accounts, regrouped and summarized for presentation.
